items.text: Lincoln spoke at the dedication of the cemetery at Gettysburg on November 19, 1863.

claims.quote: Address delivered at the dedication of the Cemetery at Gettysburg.

items.text: He began by looking back four score and seven years, to the founding of a nation built on the idea that all men are created equal.

claims.quote: Four score and seven years ago our fathers brought forth on this continent, a new nation
dedicated to the proposition that all men are created equal

items.text: Four score and seven years is 87 years, so he was counting back to 1776.

claims.quote: Four score and seven years ago our fathers brought forth on this continent, a new nation

items.text: He said it is for us the living, rather, to be dedicated here to the unfinished work which they who fought here have thus far so nobly advanced.

claims.quote: It is for us the living, rather, to be dedicated here to the unfinished work which they who fought here have thus far so nobly advanced.

items.text: He promised that the nation would endure forever.

claims.quote: this nation shall endure forever and ever
